description: Real MediaPipe PoseLandmarker output for 10 frames of IMG_4941.mov (owner-approved internal test footage, spec §8 Q1). world_landmarks/visibility/presence/image_landmarks are raw MediaPipe values rounded to 6 decimals; expected_canonical is groove_eval.canonical_skeleton.to_canonical(world_landmarks, visibility, t=t) and is the Python side of the Swift CanonicalSkeleton parity check (WO-1A). No hands: the hand model is pinned in M2.

extractor.procedure: every frame of the video decoded with OpenCV (BGR->RGB) and fed to detect_for_video with timestamp_ms = round(frame_index * 1000 / fps); the frames below are a subset of that single pass

frames.note: first downbeat (count 1, 0.53 s), segment A start
segment A, left wrist above shoulder
segment B face namaste clasp (wrists merged)
segment D overhead crown clasp (both wrists above shoulders)
